notes: Your partner now sees air strikes, missiles, artillery, explosions and ambushes as they happen, not just the results

Command split: in Settings › Multiplayer the host decides who commands the Army, Marines, Air Force, Navy and SOCOM (me, partner or shared), with one-tap presets. Orders for the other player's services are refused. Sustainment (supply runs, cadence, hubs) belongs to whoever has the Army, so the Marines ask the Army for supplies

Comms: a chat between the two commanders with support requests (fire support, reinforcements, supplies, MEDEVAC, air cover) tied to a unit, base, city or the map. Requests drop a pulsing marker on both maps and come with quick actions for the other player: the closest of their units to send, air support on a contact, convoys or airlifts to the nearest base
Move a campaign between devices without files: Settings › Campaign › Send to another device shows a code; on the other device tap Receive a campaign on the main menu and enter it
